chronology_follow_up.directive_scope: In CON-1417 the entire issue concerns the Tax Guide page. The later instruction to remove this tax section entirely and not have this section is broader than deleting only a Wise paragraph or VAT answer. It does not specify redirects or authorize a weak replacement tax-guide page. This interpretation is contextual, not a new owner decision.
chronology_follow_up.conclusion: The guide was not merely untouched after the March 5 directive: a March27 substantive rewrite and a July human-approved W9 workflow wording update retained it. The inspected history does not show deletion followed by reinstatement, nor an explicit Finance-approved reversal; it shows subsequent accepted publication edits whose policy intent conflicts with treating the older removal comment as sole current authority.
chronology_follow_up.recommendation: Do not remove the current guide solely on CON-1417. Present CON-1417 comment 34984 alongside March27 rewrite and PR 383, and ask the owner to resolve the single concrete current editorial disposition: remove the guide as instructed, or retain an approved scoped guide. Neither original tax claim can become PASS from these publication edits.
